libusb 1.0.30, vendored as prebuilt Windows x64 binaries (VS2022/MS64/dll variant) from
https://github.com/libusb/libusb/releases/tag/v1.0.30

Used for the AOA (Android Open Accessory) USB transport (Phase 7) -- control-transfer handshake
plus bulk-endpoint I/O against the phone once it's in accessory mode.

Why the DLL variant, not the "static" one: libusb's own Windows README states the static .lib
requires the caller to build with /MD (dynamic CRT); this project's Release builds use /MT
(static CRT, see windows/CMakeLists.txt) to avoid a VC++ redistributable dependency for the
installer. A DLL import lib has no such constraint -- calls cross a DLL boundary via libusb.h's
plain C API, so the caller's CRT choice is irrelevant. libusb-1.0.dll ships alongside
phonecam-host.exe the same way adb.exe does (see platform-tools/NOTICE.txt).

License: GNU LGPL 2.1 (COPYING.LGPL-2.1 in this directory). Used here as an unmodified prebuilt
dynamic library, consistent with LGPL's dynamic-linking allowance.
